Donate

Give a child a steady tomorrow.

Giving to Lighthouse is a simple bank transfer. There are no fees and no accounts to create. Please follow the three steps below.

  1. 1

    Choose your gift

    Give monthly or once. Any amount helps. Here is what a gift can cover:

    • RM30 per month
    • RM100 per month
    • RM300 per month
    • Any amount
  2. 2

    Make a bank transfer

    Use online banking or your banking app. Put the reference below so we can thank you.

    Account name

    [confirm] Exact account name

    Bank

    [confirm] Bank name

    Account number

    [confirm] 0000 0000 0000

    DuitNow

    [confirm] DuitNow ID / QR code

    Reference

    Your name + DONATION

    DuitNow QR
    [confirm] upload from the Home
  3. 3

    Send us your slip

    Send your transfer slip with your name and email to us on WhatsApp or email so we can thank you and issue a receipt [confirm: receipt / tax policy].

    WhatsApp the slip Email the slip

Give with confidence

To protect you from scams, always confirm bank details by calling the Home on +60 17-253 4566 before your first transfer.
